refind: READY screen (enter_match), biggest rw heap 0x16a0000..0x8200000, stride 0x200. P1 body: x@+0xEC (== duplicate x@+0xFC) tracks yellow sprite d/a deltas 1:1, y@+0xF0 == 128 (feet). Values are INTEGER screen-space on READY (not the fractional room-space of attract mode), so ns.fighter_records' fractional filter misses it; scan all 0x200 records with |dx - sprite_dx| < 3 across 8 d/a holds instead.
dead_ends: fractional filter in fighter_records excludes the READY fighter (positions are integer here)
default yellow_screen_x biased ~1.5px near left wall by the yellow floor strip at y126-127; exclude y>=126
two sibling draw quads also track: 0x191c800 (sword, same x/y) and 0x191c600 (arm strip, x offset -8)
space does not jump on READY (sprite_y stays ~114), so y@+0xF0 vertical check is N/A here
